capabilities: , Draw rectangles, arrows, and freehand marks.
Add multiline text and numbered markers.
Save annotated images as flattened PNG files.
extras: Works entirely within the vault and does not use the network or collect telemetry.
problem: Users need a way to visually annotate images stored in their vault without relying on external image editing software.
summary: Image Annotator provides a focused workspace to add visual notes like rectangles, arrows, and text to images within the vault, saving the result as a flattened PNG.
